rationale: Comparison for unit:shared.give against lean:Shared/State:Mode, lean:Shared/State:Reference, lean:Shared/State:Slot, lean:Shared/Syntax:Place, lean:Shared/Step:Resolve, lean:Shared/Step:Take, lean:Shared/Step:Promote, lean:Shared/Step:Give, lean:Shared/Soundness:Compatible. Give.move requires unique access and Take empties exactly the selected unique slot; Give.copy requires shared stored reference and leaves state unchanged; Give.promote requires shared access and changes only the final unique reference. All branches return the same object identity. Compatible concerns occurrences, not an object-level mode. This unit introduces its own objects and notation; it has no explicit :uses: prerequisites.
